findings.title: Shared temporary-export sweeping and unsafe test override paths can escape fixtures; sentinel proof missing.
Frontier growth, repeated enumeration, monolithic publication and scheduler progress remain unbounded or insufficiently proven.
Cancellation must stop backend work and Off must revoke existing work under adversarial real IPC; current proof incomplete.
Manual export view materializes data before final caps; cancellation and instance cleanup need end-to-end proof.
Strong mutation revision, immediate excluded-scope visibility and pre-allocation budgets lack acceptance evidence.
Session registration/heartbeat/expiry and attribution accuracy need real isolated registry lifecycle acceptance.
No final-candidate real-time overnight app/helper soak or 100k/1M full workload proof exists.
Final-candidate synthetic migration and compatible-binary rollback rehearsal not yet performed.
Historical distribution runbook conflates standard-app distribution with optional Endpoint Security extension.

rollback.rationale: Development fixture recovery is specified; final-candidate migration/compatible binary rollback must be measured at TASK-572/GATE-579 before overall closure.

monitoring.rationale: Resource measurement hooks exist, but isolated external supervisor, stop thresholds, bounded capture and overnight stability evidence have not yet been executed.
